title: Canonical normalized scalar tensorator
statement: For every morphism a of commutative condensed rings and scheme T, construct the natural isomorphism canonicalTensor : D_a(U tensor^L V) ≅ D_a(U) tensor^L D_a(V) from the generic derived tensor comparison, and prove its TensorNormalized cochain computation square [def-sfb-quotient-section-tensor-data]. No coefficient flatness or boundedness is assumed.

source.place: Tags 06YS, 06YY, 0G7E, 07A4, 07A6; sites-modules.tex Tags 03EK and 03EL. Extracted from lem-sfb-quotient-section-tensor-normalization.

proof.text: The ordinary internal scalar extension is strong monoidal by its normalized balancing map and preserves flat modules and quasi-isomorphisms between K-flat complexes. The generic bifunctor-derived tensor comparison is therefore invertible. Uncurry it without changing its components. Its generic homotopy counit square, transported through the complex quotient and the fixed localization comparisons, is exactly TensorNormalized.
